text:
Ali: Heads-up — we need to align runtime + infra on a small set of KV/prefix cache metrics for the new dashboard and SLA signal.
Maria: +1. Can we scope to what we actually need for 1) heatmap for warm prefixes, 2) eviction spikes, 3) reuse by workload?
Dan: I think those three cover most product questions. Also add a per-model prefix hit rate so we can link regressions to model rollouts.
Sasha: Agree. From infra side we need event shapes to be lightweight. Prefer counters/gauges with labels, not blobs.
Taylor: Sketch of required metrics: kvcache_requests_total (labels: result={hit,miss,evicted}, workload, model, prefix_len_bucket), kvcache_evictions_total (labels: reason, workload), kvcache_bytes_cached (gauge), kvcache_warmth_percent (gauge by workload).
Irene: How do we define prefix_len_bucket? fixed bins? e.g., 0-8,9-32,33-128,>128 ?
Ali: Yes, those bins are fine for now. Goal is to separate short common prefixes vs long conversation prefixes.
Leo: OpsBot FYI: there's a 1GB per-instance soft cap on our cache right now; dashboards should show fill% relative to instance capacity.
OpsBot: @channel Note: infra cap = 1GB per gpu-instance. Emit kvcache_instance_capacity_bytes and kvcache_bytes_cached with instance_id label.
Maria: For dashboards: 1) time series hit rate (rolling 5m), 2) stacked area by workload for reuse, 3) per-model table sorted by prefix hit delta vs baseline.
Dan: Also want an alert: sustained prefix hit rate drop > 8% over 30m for a model or workload -> paging for infra/product.
Sasha: Implementation notes: runtime can emit per-request metric increment like: 
```
# pseudo
metrics.counter("kvcache_requests_total", labels={"result":"hit","workload":"chat","model":"rwd-qa-v1","prefix_len_bucket":"9-32"})
```
Emit a sample every request is fine if it's aggregated at the collector.
Taylor: For evictions, add reason labels: memory_pressure, expiration, manual_evict. That helps correlate with autoscale events.
Irene: How about reuse by workload? Do we tag workload at request time? Some callers set workload=unknown currently. We need a contract: platform API must include workload tag in inference request header or we default to model-only.
Ali: Good catch. Product/SDK owners: can we require workload tag for next rollout? This ties to our billing + quota views too.
Maria: Product is OK to require it for first-party SDKs; for external API we should accept optional header and backfill where possible.
Leo: Observability: add trace attributes so we can correlate request latency vs cache hit. Example: trace.set_attribute("kvcache.hit","true") and record KV cache duration metric kvcache_lookup_seconds_bucket.
Sasha: We'll keep histograms coarse: buckets [0.1ms,0.5ms,1ms,5ms,10ms].
Dan: Dashboard wireframe: top row summary cards: overall hit rate, eviction/sec, cached bytes, hot prefixes. Below: workload reuse heatmap (workload x prefix_len_bucket) + per-model trend panel.
Taylor: UX note: make hit rate drop clickable -> shows recent requests with prefix examples (masked) — needs privacy filter.
Irene: Masking: strip PII by replacing any token that matches email/uuid patterns, show prefix hash instead of raw text. Add a setting to only show in private tenant view.
Ali: Ownership: runtime team emits metrics + traces. infra ingests and stores; eng-platform builds dashboard and alerts. Create a telemetry contract doc with metric names, labels, types, and cardinality limits.
Maria: Cardinality limits: enforce max model tag cardinality 50, workload cardinality 200, prefix_len_bucket small. We can't support freeform request_id labels.
Leo: For rollout UX: when we roll a model, we should compare its prefix hit profile vs canary baseline. Platform will surface an auto-check that fails if hit rate regresses > 5% and eviction/sec increases > 2x.
Dan: Can we add an experiment flag to disable prefix caching per-workload? That helps isolate regressions.
Sasha: Yep, runtime already supports cacheable=false header. We'll expose it via rollout config.
Taylor: Next steps: Sasha + Dan to draft metric proto and example emits, infra (Leo) to confirm ingestion cost, platform (Maria/Ali) to mock dashboard panels, Irene to write masking rules.
Ali: I'll create a short telemetry contract PR by EOD tomorrow. If anyone has objections to metric names/labels speak now. Otherwise we'll iterate in the PR. :thumbsup:
Maria: Sounds good. Thank you all.
Irene: I'll add privacy gating + backfill plan to the PR comments.
Leo: I'll run a quick cost estimate once Sasha posts the expected cardinality numbers.
OpsBot: Deploybot: telemetry-pr created by Ali (#345) — status: review_requested.
Ali: Thanks — ping me on the PR for quick review.
Maria: End of thread.
